view_vantage_settings: view the current Vantage API configuration settings with masked credentials
init_vantage_settings: initialize Vantage settings with API key, integration token, and base URL
update_vantage_settings: update individual Vantage configuration fields without requiring all fields
preview_vantage_export: preview Vantage export data without actually sending it to the Vantage API
export_vantage_data: export usage data in FOCUS CSV format to the Vantage API
